parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or synchronization task.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time of the log information. You can call [DescribePreCheckStatus](~~209718~~) to query the end time.
> - To query the log information of a DTS subtask within a specific time range, call [DescribePreCheckStatus](~~209718~~) to query the execution time of the DTS subtask.
- The time is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. You can use a search engine to find a UNIX timestamp converter.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description:
The keyword used to filter query results.
> Fuzzy match is used and the keyword is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of log entries per page. Valid values: **20**, **50**, **100**, **500**, and **1000**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time of the log information.

> - To query the log information of a DTS subtask within a specific time range, call [DescribePreCheckStatus](~~209718~~) to query the execution time of the DTS subtask.
- The start time is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. You can use a search engine to find a UNIX timestamp converter.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The log level of the log information. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:

- **NORMAL**: Normal.
- **WARN**: Warning.
- **ERROR**: Error.

parameters.name: SubJobType
parameters.description:
The type of the DTS task subnode. Valid values:


- **DATA_LOAD**: full data migration or initial full data synchronization.
- **ONLINE_WRITER**: incremental data migration.
- **SYNC_WRITER**: incremental data synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No.
